create_wsmultimodalmessage: create a WSMultimodalMessage with content items and MultimodalGeneratorOptions for multimodal generation
build_multimodalgeneratoroptions: build MultimodalGeneratorOptions with custom temp, top_p, and max_gen_tokens parameters
